--- Device Config: CHICAGO-CORE-RTR-01 ---

interface Loopback0

interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0

interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1

 ip access-group ACL-WAN-IN in
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/2
 description PEERING_IX_CHI-IX_RS1

!
